addPickNote: Made-to-order products count no stock, so they are not listed.
addStockHint: On hand goes {{from}} → {{to}}; the average cost updates itself.
addStockSerialsHint: On hand goes {{from}} → {{to}}, the IMEIs saved with it; the rest later, from "Add serials".
addText: The variants there now hold {{total}} in stock. Splitting by {{name}} makes new variants, so once you save, these stop selling. Their stock stays, and comes back if you take {{name}} out again.
addVague: The variants there now still hold stock. Splitting by {{name}} makes new variants, so once you save, these stop selling. Their stock stays, and comes back if you take {{name}} out again.
adjustHint: Each kg after the first adds the shop’s per-kg charge.
archiveNote: Leaves the list, no longer counts against the limit, can come back.
areaSearchPh: Search a city, district or thana
areaTaken: {{area}} is in {{zone}}. Remove it here, or take it out of that zone first.
askedHint: The shopper writes it when ordering · {{type}}
askedLong: The shopper or staff writes it when ordering. It does not split the product into variants and holds no stock.
batchHint: Each arrival takes a batch code and an expiry, both optional; the earliest expiry sells first.
batchNote: Sales take the soonest-expiring batch first; an expired batch is never sold.
cameraBlocked: The camera is blocked for this site. Allow it in the browser’s site settings and scan again, or paste a list or type them.
cancelCons: Possible because nothing arrived; it leaves "coming". Its number is never reused.
catAttrsNote: Suggestions only; never block a product.
catBehavesEdit: New products here take this type's defaults; existing ones do not change.
catBehavesHelp: Only defaults for new products; changeable later.
catChartHint: Shown on every product here and below that has no chart of its own.
catDeleteChildren_one: It has {{count}} sub-category. Move or delete it first.
catDeleteChildren_other: It has {{count}} sub-categories. Move or delete them first.
catDeleteProducts_one: It holds {{count}} product. Deleting moves it to Uncategorized; nothing is removed.
catDeleteProducts_other: It holds {{count}} products. Deleting moves them to Uncategorized; nothing is removed.
catEmpty: No categories yet. Products sell without one too.
catNote: A product can sit in several categories; one is primary.
catSlugNote: The link name is made from the name (like "shirt") and never changes.
catSuggestedNote: From the shop type's preset; rename or delete later.
catSwitchNote: The switch saves at once. Reorder from the ⋯ menu.
catTooDeep: Would go deeper than four levels
catTreeNote: Up to four levels. Deleting a category with products moves them to Uncategorized.
chartLimit: Up to 15 rows × 10 columns, 40 characters a cell.
chartNames: Name the measures in the first row and the sizes in the first column.
chartPicHint: A picture of your chart: JPG, PNG or WebP.
checkAddressH: Pick a thana to see its zone and charge.
checkStart: Pick what to count: some products, or everything in a category.
checksNone: No stock checks yet. Each count you save is kept here.
closeCons: The {{amount}} outstanding are dropped as not coming; what arrived stays. The reason is kept.
closeReasonPh: e.g. the supplier has no more
condHint: Shown on the storefront and in the Meta catalogue.
costNote: Type it by hand before the first stock arrives; receipts set it automatically after. Never shown to customers.
delDraftCons: It was never placed, so it goes for good.
errExpiryPast: That date has passed; give today or a later one.
errNotAPrice: A price is a number, like 450 or 99.50
errSerialMeasured: A product counted in a measured unit cannot carry serials: count it in pieces or turn serials off
expHint: An expired batch leaves the sellable count automatically.
fromBatchHint: Left as it is, the batch that expires first goes down.
hardNote: Cannot be undone. Past orders keep their own copy.
helpBool: Yes or no; it only describes.
helpMany: Several can be picked at once; it only describes, never splits.
helpNumber: A measured number; it can split into variants or be asked when ordering.
helpOne: One is picked; it can split a product into variants.
helpText: Shown as written; it describes, or is asked when ordering.
homeAreaHelp: A city, a district, or your own thanas.
homeAreaNote: Changing the area renames the two zones unless you named them; the charges stay.
leavingHint: Every unit has an IMEI, so say which ones leave.
leavingSomeHint: {{missing}} units have no IMEI and may leave unnamed; pick the rest.
libNameFixed: A library attribute’s name cannot change.
libOptions: Library options are the same in every shop; yours are only yours.
limitsLine: At most 3 splitting attributes and 100 variants.
linkChangeNote: The old link redirects to the new one, so shared links keep working.
linkPick: Pick a variant to add ?v= to the link.
lrNowLead: You have {{used}}, so a new product cannot be added. Everything you have keeps selling.
lrOwner: The shop owner can raise the limit.
lrRefusedLead: You have {{used}}; the new one was not added. Everything you have keeps selling.
lvEdit: Your changes to {{name}} are not saved yet. If you leave now, they are lost.
lvNew: This new product is not saved yet. If you leave now, what you entered is lost.
madeToOrderLine: Made when ordered; no stock is counted
measuredHint: Measured unit: stock and orders may be decimal.
missingHint_one: {{count}} unit short; every unit has an IMEI, so say which is missing. It leaves the stock.
missingHint_other: {{count}} units short; every unit has an IMEI, so say which are missing. They leave the stock.
mmDeleteCons: Deleting frees storage; past orders show a placeholder where it was.
mmDragHelp: To move a photo, press Space, move it with the arrow keys, then press Space again. Escape puts it back.
mmDragHint: Drag to reorder; the first is the cover. Up to {{max}} photos and one video.
movementNoteN: Recorded as {{delta}} and shown in the history.
mtoHint: No stock count, no low-stock alerts, never refused for stock.
mtoText: {{name}} holds {{count}} in stock. Made to order, it keeps no stock: the {{count}} are written off, recorded in its stock history, and it sells without counting. Counting again later starts at 0.
name: Name
needsTextNum: Only for text or a number
newVariantNote: A new variant starts at 0; after saving, add its stock from the Stock card.
noCamera: This device has no camera to scan with. Paste a list or type them.
noDelOutsideHint: While on, orders from outside {{area}} are not taken.
noUpfront: This type shows nothing extra up front; everything sits under "More settings".
notFound: This product was not found; it may have been deleted.
notePh: e.g. got wet in the rain
onSaleHint: Off, this variant is not sold; its stock stays.
openingHint: What is on the shelf now, recorded as its opening stock.
overLimit: {{names}} make {{count}} variants; at most 100. Remove some options, or make two products.
partAttributes: The describing attributes were not saved.
partChart: The size chart was not saved.
partFields: The basics or the stock and delivery settings were not saved.
partVariants: The options and variants were not saved.
partZones: Where it delivers was not saved.
pasteHint: One per line, or separated by commas. A scanner app’s list pastes too.
peArchived: This product is archived: it is not for sale and does not count against your limit.
peCopied: Copied · inactive until you turn it on
perKg: Extra per kg after the first
perKgNote: Only for weight-adjusted products. Past orders do not change.
pickCountHint: A product kept in batches is counted batch by batch, each a line of its own.
poEditHelp: Until the first delivery the supplier and the items can change.
poEmpty: No purchases yet. Order from a supplier; stock you add is recorded here too.
poPlaceHelp: Placing gives it a number and counts it as coming; items can change until the first delivery.
poRejectedAll: Everything that came was rejected, so the purchase can now only be closed short.
poSupplierHelp: Type a name: an existing one is found, a new one is made.
policyDeliveryHint: The order’s delivery charge is taken in advance
policyHint: Applied to each variant’s own price; the shop default is changed in settings.
rcvHelp: Accepted units enter stock and the average cost updates; rejected units stay outstanding (PUR-04).
rcvImeiLater: The rest can be added later from the Stock page.
retireNote: Retiring changes no existing product; it is no longer suggested for new ones.
retireOptionHint: Retired, it is not offered for new products; products that use it keep it.
retiredHint: A retired attribute is not suggested for new products; products that use it keep it as it was.
rmMany: The {{count}} variants with {{name}} hold {{total}} in stock, such as {{first}} and {{second}}. Once you save, they stop selling. Their stock stays, and comes back if you add {{name}} again.
rmOne: {{variant}} holds {{total}} in stock. Once you save, it stops selling. Its stock stays, and comes back if you add {{name}} again.
rmVague: Variants with {{name}} still hold stock. Once you save, they stop selling. Their stock stays, and comes back if you add {{name}} again.
rowSheetNote: Batches and IMEIs show only on products that keep them.
scanHint: Hold the barcode to the camera · one scan per unit
scannerHint: A USB or Bluetooth barcode scanner types here too: each scan adds a line.
serialHintAny: Any code, unique within the variant. Adding them later is fine.
serialHintImei: The phone’s IMEI, 15 digits. Scan, paste or type them when stock comes in; adding them later is fine.
serialSwitch: A serial number on every unit
serialsAllNamed: Every unit has a serial now.
serialsEntered: {{kept}} of {{units}} entered · the rest can come later
serialsFull: All {{units}} units have a serial. To add more, raise the opening stock first.
serialsFullQty: All {{units}} units have a serial. To add more, raise the quantity first.
serialsLeftOut: {{n}} flagged are not saved: fix and add them again, or remove them.
serialsNoQty: Type the quantity first: each unit takes one serial.
serialsNoUnits: Type the opening stock first: each unit takes one serial.
serialsNoneMissing: Every unit held has a serial.
serialsNote: A serial can be fixed or removed while its unit is in stock; a sold unit's serial is history.
setHint: A set fills an attribute’s options on a product in one tap.
setNeedsOptions: Give it at least one option
sharedHint: One stock in {{unit}}; selling a pack takes its amount off it.
sharedLocked: Can be switched off only once the stock is 0
sharedLockedOn: Can be switched on only once the stock is 0
shownAsTyped: Shown on the product page as typed.
snDup: This IMEI is already in this variant
snOnlyInStock: It can be fixed or removed because the unit is in stock; once sold it cannot.
stripStorage: Storage: {{used}} of {{limit}} used · images up to {{image}} MB, one video up to {{video}} MB
supArchiveHelp: Archived, it is not offered for new purchases; past ones keep its name. Never deleted (PUR-01).
supArchivedHint: Archived suppliers are not offered for new purchases; bring one back to offer it again.
supNone: No suppliers yet. Type a name on a purchase, or add one here.
supplierHint: A new name creates the supplier.
svGate: Only for those who may see costs (inventory:manage).
svLead: What is on hand at average cost; losses are damaged, expired, missing at a count and write-offs. Profit arrives with orders (Phase 4).
tapSwatch: Tap the circle beside an option to give it a swatch. A swatch belongs to the option, so it shows on every product that uses it.
upFull: Storage is full: {{used}} of {{limit}}. The upload was refused.
upFullOwner: Delete old photos, or ask the shop owner for more storage.
whyHint: A starting point only. Everything can be changed; the type never restricts a product.
woCost: The loss is recorded at average cost: ৳{{n}}
woOnly: For an expired batch. Damaged or lost stock goes through "{{edit}}" with its reason.
zoneAdd: Add a district, city or thana
zoneAutoNote: The automatic name follows your home area.
zoneDelCons: Its areas fall to the next zone that covers them. Past orders keep their charge.
zoneInUseCons: These products deliver only to this zone. Change their delivery areas first.
zoneInUseT: This zone is still in use
zonesFull: 20 zones is the most. Add new areas to a zone you have.
zonesHint: The product page says "Delivers to: {{zones}} only"; an order from outside is refused when ordering.
zonesLimit: Up to 20 zones. An area sits in one zone only. Changing a charge never changes past orders.
zonesNone: No zones of your own yet. Add one for areas whose charge differs.
